claims.claim: Discover's FY2024 10-K defines its Network Partners business as agreements with financial institutions, fintechs, networks and Network Alliances for issuing and processing on the Discover Global Network.
claims.quote: We have agreements with a number of financial institutions, financial technology firms, networks, Network Alliances and other commercial service providers (collectively, "Network Partners")
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Filed 2025-02-20, predates Capital One's May 18, 2025 acquisition.

claims.claim: PULSE uses a sponsor model: participating financial institutions may sponsor merchants, direct processors and ISOs into the PULSE POS and ATM debit service.
claims.quote: financial institution participants may sponsor merchants, direct processors and independent sales organizations to participate in the PULSE POS and ATM debit service.
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: A PULSE participating financial institution assumes liability for its cards' transactions and for rule compliance by any merchants, processors or ISOs it sponsors.
claims.quote: A participating financial institution assumes liability for transactions initiated through the use of debit cards issued by that institution, as well as for ensuring compliance
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Sentence continues: '...with PULSE's operating rules and policies applicable to that institution's debit cards, ATMs and, if applicable, sponsored merchants, direct processors and independent sales organizations.'

claims.claim: PULSE membership is governed by network participation agreements that generally auto-renew without fixed terms, and PULSE charges participation and membership fees in addition to switch fees.
claims.quote: Network participation agreements generally renew automatically and do not have fixed durations, although the Company does enter into fixed-term pricing or incentive arrangements
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Same passage: 'switch fees charged to financial institutions and merchants under network participation agreements ... as well as various participation and membership fees.' Fee amounts are not disclosed.

claims.claim: Diners Club International is a licensee (franchise) network: Discover does not issue Diners cards itself but licenses financial institutions to issue and/or acquire, in exchange for royalties.
claims.quote: We do not directly issue Diners Club cards to consumers, but grant our licensees the right to issue Diners Club cards and/or provide card acceptance services.
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'In general, our licensees pay us royalties for the right to use the Diners Club brand.' The 10-K elsewhere calls them 'Diners franchisees'.

claims.claim: Network-to-network (Network Alliance) participants join indirectly: PULSE has no direct relationship with the other network's institutions, and the partner network carries their financial responsibility.
claims.quote: PULSE does not have a direct relationship with these financial institutions and the other network bears the financial responsibility
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: The published on-ramp for payments providers is registration for the EASI portal, which provides enablement materials, technical specifications, test card kits and a Message Center to Discover's operations team.
claims.title: Payments Providers - Get Started | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page lists 'Enablement materials and technical specifications', 'Developer test card kits', 'Product information and announcements', 'Our Discover Global Network operations team via Message Center'. No certification stages, fees or timelines are stated.

claims.claim: EASI self-registration is open to eighteen named company types, spanning acquirers, issuers, processors, gateways, ISOs, ISVs, OEMs, PayFacs, resellers and N2N partners, and issues credentials by email.
claims.quote: Acquirer, Acquirer Processor, Distributor, DN Credit Issuer, DN Debit Prepaid Issuer, DN Retained Merchant, e-Commerce Gateway, e-Commerce Platform Provider, e-Commerce Shopping Cart
claims.title: EASI Portal Registration
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Full list continues: Independent Sales Organization (ISO), Independent Software Vendor (ISV), Issuer Processor, Middleware ISV, N2N Partner, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), Payment Facilitator - PayFac, Reseller/Dealer, Web Developer, Other. Form asks for a Signing Authority Name and Email and a business-purpose description; no approval workflow or timeline is stated. Form was read, not submitted.

claims.claim: The EASI registration form is a multi-stage application that collects contact, company, signing-authority and business-purpose information before credentials are issued.
claims.quote: complete the form below to receive login credentials via email
claims.title: EASI Portal Registration
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Stages observed: contact info, company details, optional colleague invites, business purpose and technical document access needs, respondent and signing authority, verification code, review and submit.

claims.claim: The Discover developer portal is invite-only: new users must submit a Contact Us form and wait for a Discover representative, and collaborators can only be added by Discover invitation.
claims.quote: Currently, developer partners can only be added with an invite from a Discover® representative.
claims.title: FAQ | Discover Developer Portal
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Also: 'To create a developer account, please contact your Discover representative or fill out the Contact Us form.' and 'Not all of our products are currently published.' No sandbox or certification described.

claims.claim: Discover's public contact form routes prospective partners into nine U.S. categories, including Acquirer, Acquirer Processor, Issuer, Prepaid Program Manager and Advanced Payments Technology Providers, rather than an online application.
claims.quote: Acquirer, Acquirer Processor, Advanced Payments Technology Providers, Business Owner, Fraud Service Provider, Issuer, Integrated Payments Providers, Prepaid Program Manager, Transaction Processor
claims.title: Contact Us | Discover Global Network Service Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Non-U.S. visitors get four categories: Acquirer, Business Owner, Issuer, Network Payment Service Provider. Categories listed as rendered on the form; form not submitted. No post-submission process stated.

claims.claim: Discover's how-we-partner page offers no published application steps, fees or timelines; it positions partnership as consultative and points to the Contact Us form.
claims.quote: Our knowledge of the payments landscape helps us design solutions to fit businesses, acquirers, issuers and other payments providers
claims.title: How We Partner | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also: 'We partner with organizations of all sizes'. Absence of steps, certification, fees and timelines is the finding.

claims.claim: For fintechs, Discover describes an ecosystem model in which BIN Sponsors, Processors and Program Managers enable the program, with 'ready-made network services' to reach market quickly; no named fast-track programme is published.
claims.quote: We bring together a powerful combination of payments capabilities and partnerships, including BIN Sponsors, Processors, and Program Managers to enable your program.
claims.title: Fintech Partnerships | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also: 'We have ready-made network services that get programs to market quickly'. CTA: 'Reach out to our team of experts'. No program name, criteria, fees or timelines.

claims.claim: Discover's Partner Directory lists only products that have passed Discover type approval, indicating a device/product type-approval certification programme, though its stages are not published on the page.
claims.quote: This list only contains specific products that have been type approved by Discover.
claims.title: Partner Directory | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Disclaimer: 'Discover's type approval does not, under any circumstances, include or imply any guarantees, assurances or warranties'. No process for getting listed is described.

claims.claim: Becoming a Diners Club issuer is handled by direct outreach to a brand mailbox; no licensing steps, fees or timelines are published.
claims.quote: Reach out to our team to learn more about the benefits and value of issuing Diners Club.
claims.title: Diners Club Issuing | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: 'Partner With Us' button is a mailto to DCIBrand@discover.com.

claims.claim: PULSE's public site organises 'Partner With Us' into three participant types, Issuers, ATM Acquirers and Merchants, and routes joining through a contact page rather than a published application.
claims.quote: Start getting more from debit. We're here to help you get the most out of every transaction.
claims.title: PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Nav links: /public/issuers/, /public/atm-acquirers/, /public/merchants/. No membership requirements or fees published on the homepage.

claims.claim: The Discover Network service center exposes separate gated portals for each partner role: Fraud and Risk Center (with MFA), eCentral for merchants, Advanced Payments Providers, EASI for acquirers/processors/issuers, and a Disputes Portal.
claims.quote: We have implemented an additional security layer, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
claims.title: Discover Network Service Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Advanced Payments Providers portal offers 'Log in' or 'Join Now' at advancedpayments.discoverglobalnetwork.com/app/; Disputes Portal at portal.discoverglobalnetwork.com/.
